description: This is a shell script ('run_l1_tests.sh') used as a test runner for a CI workflow. It contains functions for cloning repositories, ensuring the presence of required repos, and executing the main workflow for setting up test environments and applying patches.

methods.name: ensure_repo_cloned
methods.description: Ensures a git repository exists at a target directory, checking out a specific ref, cloning if necessary.

methods.name: ensure_l1_workflow_repos_present
methods.description: Clones and ensures presence of required repositories for the CI workflow, excluding entservices-testframework.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up the workspace, clones required repos, and applies patches as needed.
